description: Capability for the floating Omni pet window (200x200, transparent, always on top). Kept minimal: the pet drags itself, closes itself and brings the main window forward — everything else it needs goes through the pet_* commands. It also listens on `omni://intent`, `llm://tool-ask` and `llm://turn` and answers a pending tool permission with `llm_tool_answer`; application commands are not gated by capabilities, but the event listener is, so `core:event:default` is spelled out here rather than inherited silently from `core:default`.
